razonamiento: Merged visual boxes and spoken components into 7 nodes. The Web Server and Job Manager are drawn together as a single box (b1) hosted on EC2 as described in narration. The GPU processing cluster (b4) represents the G3 instances executing Asset Manager, Wormhole, and Spacetime packaging. IMF (b3) is connected via a spoken flow from the Job Manager. Database (b2) is kept as ThirdParty as unspecified. Lambda (b6) extracts media info from S3 (b5) and reports to Job Manager (b1). User browser uploads clips directly to S3 as mentioned in narration.
